ev.q: During 2021, approximately 6.5 million topical antifungal prescriptions were filled (134 prescriptions per 1,000 beneficiaries)
Higher-volume prescribers wrote 44.2% (2.9 million) of all prescriptions.
The highest average per prescription costs were for efinaconazole ($1,035.38), tavaborole ($784.63), and oxiconazole ($729.84)
Among 1,017,417 unique prescribers, 130,637 (12.8%) prescribed topical antifungals.
Total prescription volumes were compared between higher-volume prescribers (top 10% of topical antifungal prescribers by volume) and lower-volume prescribers.
Higher-volume prescribers wrote 44.2% (2.9 million) of all prescriptions.
By U.S. Census Bureau region, the highest prescription rate was in the Northeast (188.0 prescriptions per 1,000 beneficiaries)
Primary care physicians wrote the highest percentage of prescriptions (40.0%)
Prescription rates per 1,000 beneficiaries were calculated by drug and region
